description: pgbouncer.ini for PgBouncer 1.23/1.24 in front of the PostgreSQL primary.

fields.name: db_name
fields.description: Name clients connect to; the left-hand side of the [databases] entry.
fields.title: Pool name

fields.name: db_host
fields.description: Host of the PostgreSQL primary the pool forwards to. Filled by the server from the topology.
fields.title: Primary host

fields.name: db_port
fields.description: Port of the PostgreSQL primary. Filled by the server from the topology.
fields.title: Primary port

fields.name: db_dbname
fields.description: Database name on the primary; defaults to the pool name when unset.
fields.title: Target database

fields.name: databases_rendered
fields.description: The [databases] entry, emitted only once the server has filled db_host.

computed.expr: ("db_host" in root) && root.db_host != "" ? root.db_name + " = host=" + root.db_host + " port=" + string(root.db_port) + " dbname=" + root.db_dbname : ""

fields.title: Rendered [databases]

fields.name: listen_addr
fields.description: Addresses PgBouncer binds to. Product default '*': the load generator reaches the pooler over the network, unlike the upstream localhost-only default.
fields.title: Listen address

fields.name: listen_port
fields.description: TCP port PgBouncer listens on.
fields.title: Listen port

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: How PgBouncer authenticates clients. Product default scram-sha-256, matching PostgreSQL's own password_encryption default; upstream still defaults to md5.
fields.title: Auth type

fields.name: auth_file
fields.description: userlist.txt with the name/password pairs PgBouncer authenticates against.
fields.title: Auth file

fields.name: auth_user
fields.description: Role auth_query runs as for users missing from auth_file.
fields.title: Auth user

fields.name: auth_query
fields.description: Query used to fetch a password when auth_user is set.
fields.title: Auth query

fields.name: pool_mode
fields.description: When a server connection is returned to the pool. Product default transaction: it is the mode a benchmark pooler is deployed for; upstream defaults to session.
fields.title: Pool mode

fields.name: max_client_conn
fields.description: Maximum client connections PgBouncer accepts.
fields.title: Max client connections

fields.name: default_pool_size
fields.description: Server connections per user/database pair.
fields.title: Default pool size

fields.name: min_pool_size
fields.description: Server connections kept open even when idle; 0 disables.
fields.title: Min pool size

fields.name: reserve_pool_size
fields.description: Extra connections a pool may open once clients have waited reserve_pool_timeout; 0 disables.
fields.title: Reserve pool size

fields.name: reserve_pool_timeout
fields.description: How long a client waits before the reserve pool is used; 0 disables.
fields.title: Reserve pool timeout

fields.name: max_db_connections
fields.description: Cap on server connections per database across all pools; 0 is unlimited.
fields.title: Max DB connections

fields.name: max_user_connections
fields.description: Cap on server connections per user across all pools; 0 is unlimited.
fields.title: Max user connections

fields.name: server_idle_timeout
fields.description: Close a server connection idle longer than this; 0 disables.
fields.title: Server idle timeout

fields.name: server_lifetime
fields.description: Recycle a server connection older than this; 0 disables.
fields.title: Server lifetime

fields.name: server_reset_query
fields.description: Query run when a server connection is returned to the pool. Upstream default is `DISCARD ALL`, which is only valid in session pooling; the product default is empty because pool_mode defaults to transaction.
fields.title: Server reset query

fields.name: query_wait_timeout
fields.description: Longest a query may wait for a server connection before it is canceled; 0 disables.
fields.title: Query wait timeout

fields.name: client_idle_timeout
fields.description: Disconnect a client idle outside a transaction for longer than this; 0 disables.
fields.title: Client idle timeout

fields.name: ignore_startup_parameters
fields.description: Startup parameters PgBouncer accepts and ignores, e.g. extra_float_digits,options.
fields.title: Ignore startup parameters

fields.name: log_connections
fields.description: Log each client connection.
fields.title: Log connections

fields.name: log_disconnections
fields.description: Log each client disconnection with its reason.
fields.title: Log disconnections

fields.name: stats_period
fields.description: Interval between the aggregated statistics log lines.
fields.title: Stats period

fields.name: admin_users
fields.description: Comma-separated roles allowed to run every command on the admin console.
fields.title: Admin users

fields.name: stats_users
fields.description: Comma-separated roles allowed read-only access to the admin console; the exporter uses one of these.
fields.title: Stats users

rules.message: server_reset_query must be empty in transaction or statement pooling
